rules: Tokens only — no hex values, pixel font sizes, or hardcoded white on accent fills.
Pill-first: single-line controls use radius.control (full pill); anything tall or multi-line uses radius.card (20px); checkboxes use radius.subtle so they never read as radios.
Every component is verified in four combinations: orange/navy × light/dark, with automated contrast checks.
Native elements where they are fully stylable (button, input, checkbox, radio); React Aria where behavior is hard (select, menus, dialogs, tabs, tooltips, toasts).
Focus is always visible (border.focus ring); nothing is operable by mouse only.
Form controls share one Field pattern: label, helpText, errorText, required, disabled, readOnly.
Every component follows the interaction rules in DESIGN.md → Interaction rules (conventions.interaction).
Every component follows the API conventions in DESIGN.md → Component API conventions (conventions.api).
interaction: Hover swaps to a real hover token (or a color-mix toward text.primary where none exists); never filter or opacity tricks. Checked.
Press: :active scales to 0.98 over motion.fast; toggles use aria-pressed and take their intent's solid. Disabled and loading don't react.
Focus ring: :focus-visible only, 2px border.focus with a 2px offset at 3:1; the focused item in a group gets z-index 1. Checked.
Timing: motion.fast (color, shadow, press), motion.normal (movement and size), motion.slow (loops), motion.easing; no raw ms or s values. Checked.
Animate background, color, border-color, box-shadow, text-decoration-color, transform only; absolutely positioned indicators may animate width and height. Never animate layout.
Reduced motion: movement stops (press scale, sliding, text transitions); fades may stay; spinners slow down instead of stopping.
Loading: content keeps its space and accessible name (transparent text) with a spinner on top at 3:1 (checked); aria-busy; clicks blocked via aria-disabled; focus kept.
Disabled: native disabled, opacity 0.5, cursor not-allowed, no hover or press, exempt from contrast; anchors use aria-disabled and tabindex -1.

Touch: under pointer: coarse every control's hit area is at least 44 × 44 (interaction.minTarget), using an invisible ::after where the control looks smaller; links in running text are exempt. Checked.
api: State comes as a trio: current value (controlled), default value (uncontrolled), change callback with the new value. The callback fires either way.

Behavior: interactive behavior and state use the react-aria + react-stately hooks, as Accordion (useDisclosureGroupState + useDisclosure) and Button's toggle (useToggleState) do — never react-aria-components. Markup, class names and data attributes stay Datum's own.
Breaking changes: a removed or renamed prop is recorded in the decision log (DESIGN.md and decisions below), with what replaces it.
state: Accordion, and anything else that holds a value (fields, selects, tabs, radio groups, sliders)
Anything that opens: menus, dialogs, popovers, sheets, tooltips

decisions: Pill only. No rounded option — pill is Datum's identity, and the whole library is pill-first.
Added: bg.inverse, bg.inverseHover, text.onInverse in both themes (all contrast pairs pass).
Header, Nav and NavigationMenu merge into one Navbar with layouts, appearances, mega menus and a mobile sheet.
Light-mode fill moves from navy-900 to navy-700 (hover 600, active 800) — navy-900 was nearly identical to the ink button.
Primary buttons carry white text in both themes. Orange's fill moves from orange-500 to orange-700 (hover 800, active 900) so white passes AA at 5.67:1.
Track with a sliding raised thumb (option A), chosen over a split-pill design. Replaces joined segments with shared borders.
Mode-aware (navy slate-600/400, orange stone-500/400) — it failed 3:1 on bg.surface in three of four combinations.
Orange light moves stone-500 → stone-600: it failed 3:1 on bg.accentSubtle (accent Section).

The combo check now measures static text too. Dark text.danger / text.success move 400 → 300; text.tertiary takes secondary's step where it failed 4.5:1 on bg.surface (orange dark, navy light and dark).
Stack and Grid gaps and Section padding are derived from the space tokens (compact, default, section); Container uses grid.container and grid.margin.
Datum has two text colors (primary, secondary) plus disabled. Hierarchy comes from type roles (size, weight, case), never a third gray. Text's tone drops tertiary.
Added as a dependency (react-aria, react-stately; external in the build). Accordion is the first component on it: useDisclosureGroupState + useDisclosure, hidden="until-found" panels.
The chevron turns (motion.normal); the panel height is not animated, since that would move the content below.

value / defaultValue / onValueChange for values; open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange for things that open; react-aria + react-stately hooks, never react-aria-components; removed or renamed props are recorded here.

Card variant → appearance (flat was a surface fill plus a border: use outline for the border or soft for the fill). Badge variant → intent, appearance added (old accent, success, warning and danger fills are now solid; default soft). Avatar initials removed (derived from name), size default → md. AccordionItem defaultOpen → Accordion defaultValue with a value per item.

Every piece of component state is current / default / on-change. Booleans keep their names: pressed / defaultPressed / onPressedChange (toggle Button), checked / defaultChecked / onCheckedChange (Checkbox, Switch); otherwise value / defaultValue / onValueChange or open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange. Button gains defaultPressed.
